Instructions for Use
Device description: The Aster Infusion Pump is a implantable drug pump. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Aster Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5 T or 3 T
• Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 3 T/m
• At 1.5 T: B1+RMS of 2 uT or less; Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1 W/kg; No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session
• At 3 T: B1+RMS of 1.2 μT or less; Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.1 W/kg; Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes
• Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
• Any receive-only coil may be used
• Scan regions: Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Aster Infusion Pump is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
